You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: Move the red_block from its current location to the orange_tray. First, check if the orange_tray is occupied. If it is, clear the tray by moving any object currently on it to a free zone (e.g., the purple_box). Once the orange_tray is free, place the red_block on it. Success is confirmed when the red_block is fully resting on the orange_tray with no other object on top of it.
Goals: [{"object": "red_block", "zone": "orange_tray"}]

{"table_z": 0.8, "objects": {"red_block": {"kind": "block", "center": [0.1097, 0.0239, 0.8199], "top_z": 0.8399, "height": 0.0399, "footprint_long": 0.0396, "footprint_short": 0.0381, "long_axis_yaw": -0.695}}, "zones": {"orange_tray": {"name": "orange_tray", "center": [-0.0037, 0.1724, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0668, 0.0649]}, "purple_box": {"name": "purple_box", "center": [0.0297, -0.0871, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0556, 0.0538]}}, "gripper": {"width": 0.0795, "closed_command": false, "holding_something": false}, "end_effector": {"position": [-0.1978, 0.0002, 1.0799], "yaw": 1.579}}

object to its own destination). Skip objects that are already resting on their target zone.

{"steps": [{"object": "<object name>", "zone": "<zone name>"}, ...]}
